title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1966-07-17
source: SBD > RTR @ 15 I.p.s. > PCM > D > SSSB

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear 1966 soundboard captures rare early gems like In The Pines and Cardboard Cowboy, with Pigpen’s organ and strong keys driving the set.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its exceptional clarity and instrument separation, delivering a full‑stage feel that lets listeners hear every nuance of the 1966 performance. Highlights include the rare renditions of “In The Pines” and “Cardboard Cowboy,” plus a standout Jerry Garcia solo on “Standing.” While one reviewer noted a slight dip in overall energy, the sound quality and unique setlist make this an essential early Dead document.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (average 4.75) with detailed praise for both sound quality and performance, only minor comment about energy; ample reviews provide strong basis.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear instrument separation, crisp organ and piano, full‑stage ambience; no reported dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑era set featuring rare songs back‑to‑back, creating a unique and cohesive listening experience.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for a fine solo and excellent tone; one reviewer wanted more of his playing.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ is highlighted as clear, prominent, and "strong bouncy" throughout the show.
